classes.title: Classes
classes.hint: Group sessions: who is booked, who waits, and who came.
classes.noOffers: No classes yet. Add one under Services offered and choose the kind "class".
classes.capacityHint: Leave empty to use the number set for this class.
classes.skipped: {{count}} could not be added (closed days or clashes):
classes.emptyHint: Add a class to start taking bookings.
classes.cancelledLate: Cancelled. It was late, so the late-cancel rule applies.
classes.addPersonFull: The class is full. Add a person to the waiting list.
classes.findClient: Find a client by name or phone
classes.waitlisted: The class is full. Put on the waiting list, number {{position}}.
classes.removeWaitingMessage: This person will no longer be offered a place.
classes.cancelClassWarning: Everyone booked or waiting ({{count}}) will be told that the class is cancelled.
classes.closedHint: No class is added on these days (holidays, repairs).

recalls.title: Due again
recalls.hint: Clients who are due for their service again and have nothing booked.
recalls.search: Search by client, phone or service
recalls.emptyHint: Clients appear here when a service has "Due again after N days" set in Services offered and enough days have passed since their visit.

done.snoozed: We will show them again later.

recalls.declinedMessage: {{name}} will not be shown here again for this visit.
recalls.remindHint: They come back to this list on that day.

staffPay.title: Staff pay
staffPay.hint: Commission earned and tips held, for the period you choose.

commission.title: Commission
commission.note: Commission here is information. Nothing is paid from this screen: pay your staff the way you usually do.
commission.emptyHint: Commission appears when bills are paid and commission rules apply.

tips.title: Tips
tips.hint: Kept apart from commission. Some tips are held by the business until you hand them over.
tips.payMessage: Confirm that you handed {{amount}} in tips to {{name}}. This cannot be undone.

rules.title: Commission rules
rules.hint: The most specific rule wins. A rule with no person, level or service applies to everyone.
rules.editHint: Who it applies to cannot be changed. Add a new rule instead.
rules.emptyHint: Add a rule to see commission in the table above.
rules.anyoneHint: Leave on Everyone for all staff.
rules.levelHint: For example junior or senior, as set on the person.
rules.serviceHint: Leave on All services for every service.

rent.title: Chair and room rent
rent.hint: People who rent a chair or room from you pay a fixed amount each week or month. The bill is made for you.
rent.emptyHint: Add a renter, the amount and how often they pay.
rent.itemHint: A service item from Products, used on the bill.
rent.noItems: No service items yet. Add one in Products first.
rent.chairHint: Only to remember which one it is.
rent.endMessage: No more bills will be made for {{name}}.

dayEnd.title: Day end
dayEnd.hint: What the branch took and did on a day. Print it to keep with the cash.
dayEnd.tipsHint: The last column is what the business holds for the person.

rota.title: Who works when
rota.hint: The week at a glance: working hours and time off.
rota.emptyHint: Add people and their working hours under Staff and rooms.
rota.editNote: To change working hours, open a person under Staff and rooms.
rota.affected: {{count}} appointment(s) affected. They are not moved: move or cancel them yourself.
